tables.title: Executive Compensation Structure, Incentive Overhaul and Governance Summary

disclosure.value: 2025 Target Total Direct Compensation of $22.0M (approximating market median): $1.5M base salary, 200% ($3.0M) Annual Incentive Plan target (actual 2025 payout $3.93M at 131% One Company Score x 100% individual score), and $17.5M LTI target (55% PPSOs at 120% strike [$9.625M GDFV, 121,023 options at $221.44] / 45% 3-yr ratable RSUs [$7.875M GDFV, 42,675 units]). 2025 Summary Compensation Table total $23.58M ($31.92M SEC CAP).

rows.label: CFO Jay Malave Pay Structure & New-Hire Package

disclosure.value: Appointed EVP & CFO effective Aug 15, 2025 (succeeding Brian West): $1.05M annual base salary, 120% ($1.26M) full-year unprorated 2025 AIP target (actual payout $1.651M at 131%), no 2025 annual LTI grant. Received $18.0M non-recurring make-whole new-hire package: $8.5M cash ($1.5M forfeited unvested equity offset + $7.0M prior-employer clawback offset, subject to 2-yr full repayment upon voluntary departure), $5.0M 2-yr ratable RSUs (21,373 units), and $4.5M 3-yr cliff PPSOs at 120% strike ($280.73, 44,321 options). Boeing also paid $2.0M to former employer Lockheed Martin for release of claims. 2025 SCT total $20.18M.

governance_topic.value: Annual Incentive Plan (80% Financial / 20% Safety & Quality)

disclosure.value: 2025 shifted from separate business-unit scores to a single enterprise-wide One Company Score covering NEOs and >100,000 employees: 80% financial metrics (Free Cash Flow, Core EPS, Revenue; 0–200% curve) and 20% Safety & Execution Operational Scorecard (FAA-aligned Safety & Quality Plan KPIs: employee proficiency, notice-of-escape rework hours, supplier shortages, rework hours/airplane [cut 60% in 2025], travelers). 2025 score achieved 131% of target (with 100% individual scores for all NEOs; limited M&A adjustments for DAS divestiture and Spirit close moved FCF -$1.9B to -$0.5B, Core EPS +$1.19 to -$10.72, Rev $89.5B to $89.8B). Identical 80%/20% structure retained for 2026.

In early 2026, Compensation Committee removed 2025's interim Premium-Priced Stock Options (55% PPSOs / 45% ratable RSUs) and established a three-vehicle mix: (1) 30% 2026–2028 PSUs split 50% on 3-yr cumulative FCF targets (0–200% payout) and 50% on 3-yr relative TSR vs S&P 500 (0–200% payout, capped at 100% target if absolute TSR is negative); (2) 20% RSUs with 3-yr cliff vesting plus mandatory 2-yr post-vesting holding period; and (3) 50% RSUs with 3-yr ratable vesting (33%/33%/34%).

Three-year cumulative Free Cash Flow PSUs granted in 2023 (55% of 2023 LTI for legacy NEOs Pope, Gerry, West; vested Feb 17, 2026) paid out at 0% due to below-threshold cumulative FCF following the 737-9 door plug slowdown, 2024 IAM work stoppage, and fixed-price defense development challenges. Compensation Committee made zero discretionary upward adjustments. 2024–2026 PSUs were also tracking below threshold as of Dec 31, 2025.

rows.label: Board Refreshment, Clawbacks, Peer Group & Say-on-Pay

disclosure.value: 92% independent Board (11 of 12 nominees, independent Chair Steven Mollenkopf; 10 new independent directors since 2019 including former Alaska Air CEO Brad Tilden in Dec 2025); 85% 2025 Say-on-Pay approval; Dodd-Frank financial restatement clawback plus standalone safety/misconduct recoupment policy; no employment contracts, no change-in-control golden parachutes, no hedging/pledging, no option repricing; 2026 19-company compensation peer group updated to remove 3M and add GE Aerospace; Committee monitoring emerging U.S. government guidance on defense contractor executive pay.
